metadata.title: Privacy policy | CostaSpanish Academy
metadata.description: Information about the processing of personal data.

title: Privacy policy
intro: In accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), users are informed about the processing of their personal data.

data.title: Processed data
data.p1: Personal data provided by users through contact or pre-enrolment forms are collected.
data.p2: Data may include name, email address, language level and any information voluntarily provided.

purpose.title: Purpose of processing
purpose.p1: Data are used to manage information requests, pre-enrolments, group creation and academic communications.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.p1: The legal basis for data processing is the user’s explicit consent.

analytics.title: Analytics measurement
analytics.p1: With the user's analytics consent, Vercel Web Analytics provides first-party measurement without cookies, while Google Analytics may use first-party measurement cookies. Google Tag Manager manages the loading and configuration of Google Analytics and is not a separate analytics provider.
analytics.p2: Custom events do not include free-text form content. Consent can be withdrawn at any time from the cookie settings in the footer.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.p1: Data will be kept for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which they were collected or until deletion is requested.

rights.title: User rights
rights.p1: Users may exercise their rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and data portability.
rights.p2: Requests can be sent to the email address provided above.

security.title: Security measures
security.p1: Appropriate technical and organisational measures are applied to ensure the security of personal data.
